title: Apple reports Q2 revenue up 17% YoY to $111.18B, vs. $109.66B est., net income up 19% to $29.6B, and EPS up 22% to $2.01, above $1.95 est. (Apple)
summary: Apple: Apple reports Q2 revenue up 17% YoY to $111.18B, vs. $109.66B est., net income up 19% to $29.6B, and EPS up 22% to $2.01, above $1.95 est. — March quarter records for total company revenue, iPhone revenue, and EPS — Services revenue reaches new all-time high
contentText:
Apple :

Apple reports Q2 revenue up 17% YoY to $111.18B, vs. $109.66B est., net income up 19% to $29.6B, and authorizes an additional $100B share buyback program   —  March quarter records for total company revenue, iPhone revenue, and EPS  —  Services revenue reaches new all-time high
